cues.en: Next we're going to talk about a system from Amazon called DSSTNE.
cues.zh: 接下來要談的是 Amazon 的一套系統，叫做 DSSTNE。

cues.en: That stands for Deep Scalable Sparse Tensor Neural Engine.
cues.zh: 它的全名是 Deep Scalable Sparse Tensor Neural Engine，也就是深度可擴展稀疏張量神經引擎。

cues.en: Back when I worked in Amazon's Personalization team, our algorithms and systems were some of the most closely guarded secrets in the company but in 2016, they open-sourced DSSTNE
cues.zh: 以前我在 Amazon 個人化團隊工作時，我們的演算法與系統都是公司最嚴密保護的機密之一，但他們在 2016 年將 DSSTNE 開放原始碼，

cues.en: and published an article on exactly how to use it to produce recommendations at Amazon scale.
cues.zh: 還發表文章，具體說明如何用它來產生 Amazon 規模的推薦。

cues.en: DSSTNE makes it possible to set up deep neural networks using sparse data, like the ratings data we have when training recommender systems without writing a single line of code.
cues.zh: DSSTNE 讓你不必寫任何程式碼，就能使用稀疏資料建立深度神經網路，例如訓練推薦系統時使用的評分資料。

cues.en: All you have to do is convert your training data into the format DSSTNE expects, write a short configuration file that defines the topology of the neural network you want and how it's optimized,
cues.zh: 你只要把訓練資料轉成 DSSTNE 要求的格式，再寫一份簡短的設定檔，定義想要的神經網路拓樸與最佳化方式，

cues.en: and it does the rest.
cues.zh: 其餘工作就由它完成。

cues.en: DSSTNE also runs on a GPU, and can process massive amounts of data very quickly.
cues.zh: DSSTNE 也能在 GPU 上執行，快速處理大量資料。

cues.en: If your PC has multiple GPUs, it can even distribute the load across them and compute recommendations in parallel.
cues.zh: 如果你的電腦有多個 GPU，它甚至能把負載分散到各個 GPU，平行計算推薦。

cues.en: And, if you need to scale up even further, you can integrate DSSTNE with Apache Spark to run it across a larger cluster.
cues.zh: 如果還需要進一步擴展，也能將 DSSTNE 與 Apache Spark 整合，在更大的叢集上執行。

cues.en: Let's start by digging into an example of using DSSTNE on a single machine, and then we'll talk about how to scale it up to a cluster.
cues.zh: 先深入看一個在單機使用 DSSTNE 的範例，再來談如何擴展到叢集。

cues.en: Just to make it hit home, here is the entirety of the config file that trains a three-layer neural network on the MovieLens dataset, and it produces some really amazing results.
cues.zh: 為了讓你有具體感受，這就是在 MovieLens 資料集上訓練三層神經網路所需的完整設定檔，而且結果相當驚人。

cues.en: Amazon has really made it as simple as it can get.
cues.zh: Amazon 已經把它簡化到不能再簡單了。

cues.en: Let's walk through this a bit.
cues.zh: 一起看一下。

cues.en: We start off with some information about the neural network at a high level, we are creating a feed-forward autoencoder.
cues.zh: 一開始是神經網路的高階資訊。我們要建立一個前饋式自編碼器。

cues.en: Specifically it's something called a sparse autoencoder.
cues.zh: 具體來說，它叫做稀疏自編碼器。

cues.en: In this context, sparsity refers to placing constraints on the hidden layer to force them to find interesting patterns, even if there are a large number of hidden nodes.
cues.zh: 在這個脈絡中，稀疏性是指對隱藏層施加限制，迫使它找出有意義的模式，即使隱藏節點很多也一樣。

cues.en: The values under SparsenessPenalty define those constraints.
cues.zh: SparsenessPenalty 底下的數值定義了這些限制。

cues.en: The details of what these values represent would require you to find the lecture notes from Andrew Ng's CS294A course at Stanford about sparse autoencoders,
cues.zh: 要了解這些值的詳細意義，需要找 Andrew Ng 在 Stanford CS294A 課程中，關於稀疏自編碼器的講義，

cues.en: but those are available online, however, usually the defaults are a decent starting place.
cues.zh: 那些講義在網路上找得到。不過，預設值通常就是不錯的起點。

cues.en: Next, we specify that we don't want to bother shuffling the indices, but we are applying denoising which will randomly flip one inputs to zero for the probability specified, in this case, 20%.
cues.zh: 接著指定不必打亂索引，但會套用去雜訊處理，依指定機率，隨機將值為 1 的輸入改成 0，這裡的機率是 20%。

cues.en: This forces the hidden layer to discover more robust features instead of just converging on one-to-one relationships, by making it reconstruct the input from a corrupted version of it.
cues.zh: 這會迫使隱藏層從遭破壞的輸入版本重建原始輸入，找出更穩健的特徵，而非只收斂到一對一的對應關係。

cues.en: It's kind of weird, but we talked about this a bit in our deep learning tutorial, you get better results by forcing your neural network to work harder, be it from hiding information from it,
cues.zh: 這有點奇怪，不過我們在深度學習教學中談過：迫使神經網路更費力地學習，能得到更好的結果。不論是隱藏部分資訊，

cues.en: or in this case, straight up messing with its inputs on each iteration during training.
cues.zh: 還是像這裡一樣，在訓練的每次迭代直接擾亂輸入。

cues.en: Next we define the parameters for our loss function.
cues.zh: 接著定義損失函數的參數。

cues.en: These are actually a little bit different from the defaults, which are 0.9, 0.1, 1.0, and 1.0, so I think some hyperparameter tuning has already been done for this example.
cues.zh: 這些值其實與預設值有些不同，預設值是 0.9、0.1、1.0 和 1.0，所以我想這個範例已做過一些超參數調校。

cues.en: It's not far off, so the default values are probably still a good starting place.
cues.zh: 差距不大，因此預設值應該仍是不錯的起點。

cues.en: Finally we get to the meat of it, the Layers, where we define the layers of our neural network.
cues.zh: 最後來到核心部分 Layers，在這裡定義神經網路的各層。

cues.en: Ours defines three layers.
cues.zh: 這個網路定義了三層。

cues.en: The first is the input layer, note that we specify it is Sparse.
cues.zh: 第一層是輸入層，注意我們把它指定為 Sparse。

cues.en: This is what makes DSSTNE special, it's built for the case where most of the input data is missing.
cues.zh: 這正是 DSSTNE 的特色，它就是為大部分輸入資料缺失的情況而設計。

cues.en: The input case here is a lot like the RBM example we looked at earlier, for each user we train our network with, we have an input node for every possible item, which is set to one if the user rated that item
cues.zh: 這裡的輸入情況很像先前的 RBM 範例：對每位用來訓練網路的使用者，每個可能的項目都有一個輸入節點；使用者若評過該項目，就設為 1，

cues.en: but the vast majority of items were not rated by any given user.
cues.zh: 但對任一使用者而言，絕大多數項目都沒有評分。

cues.en: This means our input data is very sparse, and by specifying this layer as sparse, DSSTNE knows this and can deal with it efficiently.
cues.zh: 這代表輸入資料非常稀疏。把這一層指定為稀疏，DSSTNE 就能知道這一點，並有效率地處理。

cues.en: We set N to auto, meaning it will set up as many input nodes as we have inputs in the data file, and that data file is given by the file named gl_input.
cues.zh: 我們把 N 設為 auto，代表資料檔案中有多少個輸入，就建立多少個輸入節點，而資料檔案是名為 gl_input 的檔案。

cues.en: Our second layer is the hidden layer, specified as such.
cues.zh: 第二層是隱藏層，這裡也明確指定了。

cues.en: It is fully connected, with 128 nodes, and a sigmoid activation function.
cues.zh: 它是全連接層，有 128 個節點，使用 Sigmoid 激活函數。

cues.en: It too is sparse.
cues.zh: 它同樣是稀疏的。

cues.en: And finally we have our output layer.
cues.zh: 最後是輸出層。

cues.en: We give it the answers for training purposes in the gl_output file, and set N to auto so it can adapt to the structure of the features in gl_output we are trying to predict.
cues.zh: 我們透過 gl_output 檔案提供訓練用的答案，並把 N 設為 auto，讓它能依照 gl_output 中要預測的特徵結構調整。

cues.en: It too has a sigmoid activation function, which is what we generally use for binary output.
cues.zh: 它也使用 Sigmoid 激活函數，這通常用於二元輸出。

cues.en: To take a step back, you may have noticed that this architecture seems to assume binary inputs and outputs, but the MovieLens rating data exists on a one-to-five scale.
cues.zh: 退一步看，你可能注意到這個架構似乎假設輸入與輸出都是二元值，但 MovieLens 的評分資料是從一到五。

cues.en: It turns out that in this example, they discard the actual rating values themselves, they take any rating as an implicit, binary indication of interest in the movie.
cues.zh: 原來這個範例捨棄了實際評分值本身，把任何評分都視為對電影有興趣的隱含二元訊號。

cues.en: And it works surprisingly well.
cues.zh: 而且效果出乎意料地好。

cues.en: However, you could do the same trick we did with RBMs and model each rating value as an individual binary classification to get finer grained results and predictions.
cues.zh: 不過，你也可以套用先前 RBM 的做法，把每個評分值建模成獨立的二元分類，取得更細緻的結果與預測。

cues.en: Let me show you this in action.
cues.zh: 來實際示範。
